"The first stage might be customer discovery. The tool could ask the user to talk to 10 to 15 students who are currently looking for jobs. It could provide tasks such as finding potential users through LinkedIn, GitHub, Kaggle, university communities, or other relevant sources."

""
"After completing the interviews, the user would return and upload their notes, chats, transcripts, or answers. The platform would analyze the findings and determine the next experiment, such as a fake-door or pretotyping test."
""
"The process would continue iteratively: customer interviews → share results → analyze findings → run experiment → share results → continue based on evidence."
"The platform would also help identify competitors, alternative solutions, target users, positioning, and existing products."
""
"The goal is not simply to help users build their idea, but to help them determine whether they should build it in the first place."

"I read a concept from the book Range by David Epstein."
""
"There was a concept of kind domains and wicked domains."
""
"Kind domain is predictable. Mostly you know what will happen next. Rules, laws, principles are applied, and similar things happen again and again."
"Examples: Chess, cricket (I believe), hockey, customer calls, and other roles where you can predict many situations."
""
"Wicked domain is unpredictable (you can only make assumptions), no fixed rules, changes with time, and many unknowns."
"Examples: Founders, politicians, gang leaders, product managers, and similar roles."
""
"In kind domains, I think you do not need huge or very unique intelligence. You mostly practice, and after enough years you start memorizing patterns."
""
"For example, chess players are not intelligent because they play chess better. They play better because they have memorized a huge number of patterns. That is also why today a machine has almost a 100% probability of beating the world's best chess player."
""
"So I think:"
"People popular in kind domains are not intelligent because they are good at their sport or role. They are good because they started early, practiced a lot, and gained huge experience."
""
"Kind domains do not change the world. Wicked domain roles change the world. People in wicked domains think outside the box and really contribute to society."
""
"Most people who literally changed the world came from wicked domains."
"Gandhi ji, Nelson Mandela, Bhagat Singh, Martin Luther King Jr., Larry Page, Bezos, great scientists, and many others."
""
"Kind domains are mainly for entertainment or to support people working in wicked domains."
""
